data.name: Neerada
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word नीरद (nīrada), meaning swift as water. In Hindu mythology, Neerada was the name of a celestial musician who played the veena (a traditional Indian string instrument) and was the charioteer of Lord Indra. He was also believed to be a sage and a poet.

It represents the idea of being swift and graceful in action, much like water flowing through a river. Moreover, as the charioteer of Lord Indra and a celestial musician, Neerada is a symbol of devotion, music, and poetry, inspiring spiritual growth and creativity within those who bear the name.
